aṭṭhita.p: [Ā+ṭhā+ta.] (ti) Google Translate Built-in Thoughtful aṭṭhita အ⁇ တ⁇ တ (တိ) [န +⁇ တ⁇] (1) not established; He (a) is not based on the two evils. He (b) has no intention of being the cause of existence. He (c) is not established in the first ten Dhamma of meritorious deeds. He is the one who has attained the standard of Parinibbana, which is no longer visible. He (3) is not standing still. Who will be running; He (iv) does not stop; Always Vow - See also
